verdict.rationale: An online legal-services platform could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant for operating its services, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such capability. The 'AI-powered creation of meeting minutes' is a separate generative feature, not natural-language control of the product. The llms.txt file is guidance for AI crawlers, not a way to issue commands. Human specialists and attorney consults are not AI operation either.
